Migrant Boat Tragedy Near Spain, Thousands Protest Crisis

A boat carrying migrants was found drifting near Spain's Canary Islands, with five confirmed dead and dozens missing. The vessel had been at sea for weeks. In a separate event, thousands of people protested in Spain over the ongoing migration crisis, particularly concerning the situation in Ceuta. European Union interior ministers expressed solidarity with Spain and commended its response to the crisis.
